content:
BUILT CoLAB celebrated its 6th Anniversary on 18 September!

This was an opportunity to bring the team together and strengthen bonds, with a Teambuilding activity, in which employees had the chance to implement strategies together.

Several associates were also present at this event, where a review was made of the 6 years of activity of this Collaborative Laboratory and the outlook for the coming year was discussed.

In this way, BUILT CoLAB continues to consolidate its path, with the aim of fulfilling its mission: to promote the Twin Transition in the AEC Sector.
